title: Extension of a live segment
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $F$ be a set of states (including the possibility of the halting state), and let $P$ be a property of work-tape head positions. Suppose a computation from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time $u<t$, and satisfies $P$ at every time $u\le t$. If $b$ is not halted, then the same computation segment also avoids $F\cup\{\text{halt}	ext{ state}\}$ at every time before $t$, while still satisfying $P$ through time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: The run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps
The state at every time $u<t$ is outside $F$
The work-tape head positions satisfy $P$ at every time $u\le t$
